title: VL-DocIR: A Benchmark for Vision-Based Long Document Information Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.17057v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-based document retrieval has improved rapidly, but current evaluation settings still emphasize short documents and single relevant pages. This leaves an important gap between leaderboard performance and realistic long-document retrieval, where the evidence needed to answer a query may span multiple pages or even multiple documents. We present VL-DocIR, a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete visual long-document retrieval. VL-DocIR is built from 29,641 HTML-born documents rendered into 388,548 page images from Wikipedia, arXiv, PubMed, and SEC proxy statements. It contains 271,760 queries across 23 domains and six evidence structures, covering single-page, within-document multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations. translated_title: VL-DocIR：面向基于视觉的长文档信息检索的基准测试
translated_abstract: 基于视觉的文档检索技术发展迅速，但当前的评测设置仍然侧重于短文档和单个相关页面。这导致排行榜成绩与真实的长文档检索场景之间存在重要差距——在真实场景中，回答查询所需的证据可能跨越多个页面甚至多个文档。我们提出了 VL-DocIR，这是一个面向证据完整的视觉长文档检索的页面级基准。VL-DocIR 由来自 Wikipedia、arXiv、PubMed 和 SEC 代理声明中的 29,641 个 HTML 原生文档构建，渲染为 388,548 张页面图像。它包含覆盖 23 个领域和六种证据结构的 271,760 个查询，涵盖单页、文档内多页以及跨文档等多种证据配置。证据标注锚定于渲染页面和 HTML 元素标识符，查询则通过一个针对清晰性、正确性、封闭性以及缺失显式线索等维度进行过滤的清洗管线进行处理。
tldr: 提出了 VL-DocIR，一个面向证据完整的视觉长文档检索的页面级基准，包含来自 29,641 个文档的 388,548 张页面图像和 271,760 个查询，覆盖单页、文档内多页及跨文档等多种证据结构，弥合了现有评测与真实长文档检索之间的差距。
en_tdlr: VL-DocIR is a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete vision-based long document retrieval, built from 29,641 documents rendered into 388,548 page images with 271,760 queries spanning 23 domains and single-page, multi-page, and cross-document evidence configurations.
